summary: Captions are now one layer called Captions: one row in the layers list, one box on the picture that you drag, size and rotate like a rectangle, and a Text section for its font, size, weight, colour, background and alignment. The Bottom, Middle and Top setting is gone.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a recording with somebody talking and let the captions write themselves.

try.do: Click Captions in the layers list.
Drag the words on the picture up to the top.
In the Text section, set Size to 64 px.
Drag the box's right handle inwards to wrap the words narrower.
Click another layer, then click the words on the picture: Captions is picked again.
Double-click one word on the picture to fix just that word.

evaluate: Does picking, moving and resizing Captions feel exactly like doing it to a rectangle?
Is the Text section where you expected the caption font and size to be?
When the type gets bigger the box grows upwards from its bottom edge. Is that the edge you want to stay put?
Should the style (Caption, Lower third, Karaoke) and the active word colour also move up into the Text section, or stay in Captions?
rough: Background is a colour list (None, Dark, Black, White) rather than the full colour picker a shape uses, and the plate has no corner radius control yet.
Effects (shadow, glow, stroke) apply to the whole Captions layer through the ordinary Effects list; they were not walked on a caption in this pass.
The rotate handle is there, but no walk rotated a Captions layer, and a word opened for fixing on a rotated layer sits level.
Animate a property is offered on the Captions layer; keyframing its opacity, position and scale belongs to the keyframe task and was not walked here.

Side by side with the captions mock (video-captions.html, Properties panel): the mock has no Text section and styles captions through a named Caption style plus a Text shadow effect; the shipped panel adds Text above Appearance because the user asked for the controls a text layer has. The mock's Guides (Safe areas) row is still missing (its own open task).
Duplicating a Captions layer gives a second one you can move and style on its own, but Write Again only rewrites the first.
